foxes.prompt:
Use case: compositing. Asset type: transparent character sprites to add TWO small resting foxes to the stone mountain path in the reference lofi shrine scene.
Image1 is exact style and lighting reference ONLY. Do NOT redraw the shrine or person. Create a 2-COLUMN x1-ROW transparent spritesheet, equal invisible cells, landscape canvas. Only one complete fox per cell, no other objects, no text, no border, no floor or shadow blobs.
LEFT cell: one WHITE fox, warm ivory-white fur with soft grey-cream shadow, long pointed muzzle, pointed ears, slim adult fox proportions, long fluffy white tail.
RIGHT cell: one YELLOW / GOLDEN-OCHRE fox (clearly yellow-gold rather than orange-red or brown), cream chest and paws, cream-white tail tip, long pointed muzzle and pointed ears, slim adult fox proportions, long fluffy tail.
Both lie flat on their stomachs, quietly resting with head lowered on their front paws and eyes gently closed or half-closed. Viewed slightly from above in3/4 SIDE view, head pointing LEFT in both cells. They will be small secondary animals on the path. Natural adult foxes, not dogs, not cats, not big-headed baby mascots. No clothes, masks, ornaments or magic effects.
Animation geometry is crucial: each fox's BODY is low and horizontal, head and front paws occupy left10-35% of its cell, shoulders and torso35-65%, hindquarters around65%. ONE CONTINUOUSLY ATTACHED long fluffy TAIL extends from hindquarters toward RIGHT, reaching about95% of cell width. Tail is visible clear of the body to the right, gently raised in a shallow smooth arc, and can wag without covering head or paws. Do not curl tail into a ball across its body. Complete tail-to-rump joint, no detached tail, no extra legs or double tails. Tail and body are ONE connected silhouette.
Keep equivalent scale and pose in both cells, generous transparent padding all around, all ear tips, paws and tail tips fully inside their own cell. Transparent background with TRUE ALPHA. No ground/stone/grass under them. No cast shadow baked into sprite; that will be added in scene.
Style: match the shrine reference's fine textured ILLUSTRATED PIXEL ART, tiny discrete pixels and warm daylight. Modest earthy colors, readable fur clusters, no smooth anime outlines, no photorealism, no3D, no coarse8bit. Each fox will be rendered only about60-80pixels wide in the scene, so an elegant simple silhouette matters more than extremely fine fur.
